scheme_name: Grant of Subsidy for Purchase of Mobile Sea Food Van
other_conditions: Applicant must belong to the fishermen community
Applicant must be a resident of the Union territory of Puducherry by birth/domicile
Applicant must be a non‑overdue member of the Primary Fisheries Co‑operative Society concerned
Applicant must not be employed in Government, Government Undertaking, or societies, either part‑time or full‑time

Applicant must be a registered Fisherwomen Co‑operative Society in the Union territory of Puducherry, or a group under SHGs registered under the District Rural Development Agency and Puducherry Urban Development Agency
benefits_summary: Provides a 75% subsidy on the cost of a mobile seafood van, with the remaining 25% financed through a bank loan.
documents_required: Copies of all mandatory documents (self‑attest, if required)
